name: mcp__metersphere_test__metersphere_functional_execution_submit
description:
Validate original-step coverage and evidence structure, then publish Agent-reported results. Extra and repeated positions are retained; any ERROR makes the case ERROR. No expected-text comparison or content reviewer. ACCEPTED/PUBLISHED means structure accepted, not independently verified execution. Requires FUNCTIONAL_SUBMIT and CASE_ATTACHMENT.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__metersphere_test__metersphere_functional_execution_submit(args: { caseId: string; contentHash: string; policyHash: string; projectId: string; requestId: string; steps: Array<{ actual: string; evidenceIds: Array<string>; result: "SUCCESS" | "ERROR"; stepNum: number; }>; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ result: { [key: string]: unknown; } | unknown[] | string | number | number | boolean | null; }>>; };
```

name: mcp__metersphere_test__metersphere_functional_execution_evidence_upload
description:
Stage a PNG/JPEG evidence file as base64 (max 5 MiB), bound to case contentHash and 1-based stepNum. Requires FUNCTIONAL_SUBMIT and CASE_ATTACHMENT. Not visible until gate passes.

exec tool declaration:
```ts
declare const tools: { mcp__metersphere_test__metersphere_functional_execution_evidence_upload(args: { base64: string; caseId: string; contentHash: string; contentType: "image/png" | "image/jpeg"; fileName: string; projectId: string; purpose: "BEFORE_STEP" | "AFTER_STEP"; requestId: string; stepNum: number; }): Promise<CallToolResult<{ result: { [key: string]: unknown; } | unknown[] | string | number | number | boolean | null; }>>; };
```
